ambiguity: Often mistaken for a generic paragraph, indent, or next-section icon by users unfamiliar with bidirectional text controls; at small sizes the pilcrow can look like the letter P or pi.

reasoning: This is a rich-text editor toolbar icon for setting left-to-right text direction (a pilcrow above a right arrow). As a formatting control/setting, it is interface chrome rather than a real-world task subject, and outside of rare localization engineering tasks it is easily confused with a generic paragraph symbol or the letter P.
